name: mirage
text: ParlayAPI: still spending about 17 credits a minute, roughly 40% of it from the live play-by-play stream (5 sports, a new 5-credit connection about every 5 minutes each). I'm making the engine log how long each connection lasts and why it ends, so I can stop it re-opening what it doesn't need; the other 60% is the scans, which now stay inside a day's share.
